name: html-head-meta-description-surfaced
description: Named head metadata (meta name=description and social property tags) must surface in the transform result instead of being silently stripped, so consumers can consciously carry it to the destination document.

source_reference.notes: Derived from design-preview pipelines where meta name=description vanished between authored HTML and preview output with no fallback or diagnostic, reading as a malformed design rather than a deliberate omission.

legacy_comparison.reason: Covers current PHP transformer head metadata reporting; no downstream legacy comparison.
